runbook.title: Theatre contacts
runbook.intro: Old Mill Playhouse: who we deal with and the numbers we use.

procedures.title: the held-seats release
procedures.intro: Ask Tixline to release {n} held seats for Saturday. Their support address is {value}.
short: Ask {alias} to release {n} held seats for Saturday.
Release {n} held seats with {alias} please.

procedures.title: the listings entry
procedures.intro: Send the Gazette our listings entry: {n} performances next month. Their listings address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} our listings entry: {n} performances next month.
Listings entry to {alias} please - {n} performances.

procedures.title: the licence return
procedures.intro: Send the licensing team this month's return: {n} events held. Email them at {value}.
short: Send {alias} this month's return: {n} events held.
Licence return to {alias} - {n} events.

procedures.title: the costume hire
procedures.intro: Hire {n} costumes for the next show. Costumes come from {name} ({value}).
short: Hire {n} costumes for the next show.
We need {n} costumes for the next show - book them please.

procedures.title: the lighting hire
procedures.intro: Hire {n} extra moving lights for the tech. We hire from {name} - bookings to {value}.
short: Hire {n} extra moving lights for the tech.
Book {n} more moving lights for the tech please.

procedures.title: the bar order
procedures.intro: Send the weekly bar order: {n} cases of soft drinks. Drinks come from {name} - orders to {value}.
short: Do the weekly bar order: {n} cases of soft drinks.
Bar order time - {n} cases of soft drinks.

procedures.title: the tech rehearsal
procedures.intro: Put the tech rehearsal on {date} in the theatre calendar - techs run {value}.
short: Put the tech rehearsal on {date} in the theatre calendar.
Add {date}'s tech rehearsal to the calendar please.

procedures.title: the youth workshop
procedures.intro: Book the youth workshop for {date} in the calendar. Workshops run {value}.
short: Book the youth workshop for {date} in the calendar.
Youth workshop on {date} - put it in the calendar.

procedures.title: a box-office shift
procedures.intro: {who} is helping out - add their box-office shift on {date} to the calendar. Shifts run {value}.
short: {who} is helping out - add their box-office shift on {date} to the calendar.
Can you put {who}'s box-office shift in the calendar for {date}?

procedures.title: the room-hire note
procedures.fact: the studio's hire rate per evening
procedures.intro: Email the bookings team ({to}) the room-hire note for the week of {date}. The studio is {value} an evening.
short: Send the bookings team the room-hire note for the week of {date}.
Room-hire note to bookings please, week of {date}.

procedures.title: the bar float request
procedures.intro: Ask the treasurer ({to}) for the bar float for the week of {date} - it's {value}.
short: Ask the treasurer for the bar float for the week of {date}.
Bar float request please, week of {date}.

procedures.title: the show report
procedures.intro: Send the stage manager the show report: {n} cues changed. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the stage manager the show report: {n} cues changed.
Show report to the stage manager - {n} cues changed.

procedures.title: the ushers' rota
procedures.intro: Send the front-of-house manager next week's ushers' rota: {n} shifts. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the front-of-house manager next week's ushers' rota: {n} shifts.
Ushers' rota to front of house please - {n} shifts.

procedures.title: the arrival reminder
procedures.fact: how early volunteers arrive before doors
procedures.intro: Email the volunteers ({to}) this week's reminder: arrive {value} before doors.
short: Email the volunteers this week's arrival reminder.
Send the volunteers the arrival reminder.

procedures.title: the studio-capacity reminder
procedures.fact: the most people allowed in the studio
procedures.intro: Email the hirers ({to}) the reminder: the studio holds at most {value}.
short: Email the hirers the studio-capacity reminder.
Send the hirers the reminder about the studio limit.
procedures.doc_rule: The studio holds at most {n} people

procedures.title: the interval reminder
procedures.intro: Email the bar team ({to}) the reminder: the interval lasts {value}.
short: Email the bar team the interval reminder.
Send the bar team the reminder about the interval.
